# Security Policy

WinUtil Pro runs with administrator rights and makes system-wide changes, so security reports are welcome.

## Reporting

For a problem in code specific to this fork, contact the maintainer through [apexsofteck.com](https://apexsofteck.com). Please do not post exploit details publicly before they are fixed.

For a problem that also exists in the original WinUtil, report it to the [upstream project](https://github.com/ChrisTitusTech/winutil) so every fork gets the fix.

## Scope

In scope:

- The compiled `winutil.ps1` and the sources it is built from.
- The launcher at `6t9xstar.github.io/win` and the release assets.
- Anything WinUtil Pro downloads and runs.

Out of scope:

- Third-party applications WinUtil Pro installs. Report those to their own vendors.
- Risks inherent to a tweak the user chose to apply, when they are described in its documentation.
